BriefInstructions: Step 1: Soak rice and dal.
Step 2: Grind the soaked rice and dal.
Step 3: Ferment the mixture.
Step 4: Cook the batter on a hot griddle.
Suggestion: Use less oil for a healthier version.

BriefInstructions: Step 1: Prepare a tangy tamarind extract.
Step 2: Add chopped tomatoes and spices.
Step 3: Cook until the soup thickens.
Step 4: Garnish with coriander leaves and serve hot.
Suggestion: Add less salt or sugar for a healthier option.

BriefInstructions: Step 1: Soak rice and dal.
Step 2: Grind the soaked rice and dal.
Step 3: Ferment the mixture.
Step 4: Steam the batter in idli molds.
Suggestion: Use less salt for a healthier version.

BriefInstructions: Step 1: Cook toor dal and vegetables.
Step 2: Add tamarind and spices.
Step 3: Simmer until the stew thickens.
Step 4: Serve hot with rice or idli.
Suggestion: Use less oil to make it lighter.

BriefInstructions: Step 1: Marinate chicken with yogurt and spices.
Step 2: Cook the marinated chicken.
Step 3: Layer the cooked chicken with rice.
Step 4: Steam the biryani until cooked.
Suggestion: Use less oil and ghee for a healthier version.

BriefInstructions: Step 1: Roast gram flour in ghee.
Step 2: Add sugar and stir until thickened.
Step 3: Pour into a greased tray and cut into pieces.
Suggestion: Use less ghee for a lighter version.

Ingredients: Mixed-Vegetables, Coconut, Green Chillies, Cinnamon, Cloves, Cashews
BriefInstructions: Step 1: Grind coconut, spices, and cashews into a paste.
Step 2: Cook vegetables with this paste and water.
Step 3: Simmer until thick.
Step 4: Serve with chapati or rice.
Suggestion: Replace cashews with almonds for a lower calorie option.

Ingredients: Cooked rice, lemon juice, mustard-seeds, turmeric-powder, green chillies, curry leaves, peanuts, oil or butter.
BriefInstructions: Step 1: Heat oil or butter and temper mustard seeds, curry leaves, and green chillies.
Step 2: Add turmeric powder and peanuts.
Step 3: Mix the tempering with cooked rice and lemon juice.
Step 4: Serve warm.
Suggestion: Use less oil and add roasted peanuts for crunchier texture.

Ingredients: Semolina, Vegetables, Mustard seeds, Curry leaves
BriefInstructions: Step 1: Roast semolina until golden and keep aside.
Step 2: Heat oil and temper with mustard seeds and curry leaves.
Step 3: Sauté chopped onions, green chilies, and vegetables.
Step 4: Add water, salt, and bring to a boil.
Step 5: Slowly stir in the roasted semolina and cook until fluffy.
Step 6: Garnish with coriander and serve hot.
Suggestion: Add nuts like cashews for extra flavor and nutrition.

Ingredients: Rice, Moong Dal, Black pepper, Cumin, Ghee, Cashews, Curry leaves
BriefInstructions: Step 1: Cook rice and moong dal together until soft.
Step 2: Heat ghee and fry pepper, cumin, and cashews.
Step 3: Mix the tempering with cooked rice and dal.
Step 4: Garnish with curry leaves and serve hot.
Suggestion: Use less ghee and add vegetables for a healthier version.

Ingredients: Mixed-Vegetables, Coconut, Curd, Green Chillies, Curry leaves, Coconut oil
BriefInstructions: Step 1: Cook mixed vegetables until soft.
Step 2: Grind coconut and green chillies into a paste.
Step 3: Mix the paste with cooked vegetables and add curd.
Step 4: Simmer and garnish with coconut oil and curry leaves.
Suggestion: Use low-fat curd for a lighter version.

Ingredients: Chicken, Onion, Tomato, Coconut, Spices, Curry Leaves
BriefInstructions: Step 1: Roast and grind coconut with spices to make a masala.
Step 2: Sauté onions, tomatoes, and curry leaves.
Step 3: Add chicken and the ground masala, then cook until done.
Step 4: Garnish with fresh curry leaves and serve hot.
Suggestion: Reduce the amount of oil for a lighter curry.

Ingredients: Milk, Vermicelli or Rice, Sugar, Ghee, Cardamom, Nuts and Raisins
BriefInstructions: Step 1: Roast vermicelli or rice in ghee.
Step 2: Boil milk and cook the roasted vermicelli or rice until soft.
Step 3: Add sugar and cardamom, then simmer.
Step 4: Garnish with roasted nuts and raisins before serving.
Suggestion: Use jaggery instead of sugar for healthier version.
